original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_GPU0 through TEMP_UBB_GPU7 as eight UBB GPU thermal channels, proving physical module and sensor identity plus consistent names, descriptions, readings and states across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The platform owner maps each UBB GPU index to fitted module serial/UUID/BDF and sensor source, supplies operating-condition limits and Web mappings, then automation performs passive complete cross-path collection.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner binds GPU0–GPU7 to fitted modules and exact sensing points, approves condition-specific limits and Web entries. No workload, GPU reset, fan change or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: UBB assembly/revision and GPU0–GPU7 physical position map
Fitted GPU module serial/UUID/BDF, firmware and applicability per index
Sensor source as GPU junction, external probe, board proxy or derived value
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per member
Units, scale, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges and enabled thresholds under documented load, power, cooling and ambient state
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/UBB/GPU spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent GPU/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Enumerate eight exact records; never query the tilde label as one sensor
Bind each value to module serial/UUID/BDF and physical UBB position
Distinguish GPU junction from external/proxy temperature before applying limits
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web
Do not start workload, reset GPU, change power/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on population mismatch, missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe thermal state, XID/link fault or path mismatch; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, UBB GPU topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact mapped records
Prepare Web parity and passive GPU/XID/power/fan/SEL context
Perform no workload, GPU/fan/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm Web mapping and unpopulated handling
Review all eight channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets UBB GPU0–GPU7 sensors across IB/OOB and Web. Missing physical mapping and criteria are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive eight-channel UBB GPU thermal check is identifiable; mapping and limits are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds stable GPU identity and sensing-source provenance, restores all cross-path views and prevents GB GPU evidence from being reused for a distinct topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU indices are not stable hardware identities, especially after service or enumeration changes. UBB position plus module UUID/serial/BDF must anchor every record. Junction telemetry and a board proxy also have different time constants and allowable ranges, so sensor-source provenance determines the correct SPEC comparison.
